CafeBranch.title: CafeBranch
CafeBranch.description: Dynamic restaurant branch managed by SuperAdmin for scalable multi-branch routing and order isolation.

shortLabel.description: Compact label shown in pickers and dashboards (e.g. Branch 3 (Johar Town)).

shortAddress.description: Physical street address of the branch.

areas.description: Neighborhoods/zones served by this branch for delivery routing.

latitude.description: Branch WGS84 latitude for GPS nearest-branch sorting.

longitude.description: Branch WGS84 longitude for GPS nearest-branch sorting.

mapUrl.description: Official Google Maps share link for directions.

deliveryRadiusKm.description: Maximum local delivery radius in kilometers.

active.description: Whether this branch is actively accepting orders.

MenuItem.title: MenuItem
MenuItem.description: Fast-food menu item available globally across Lahori Food Cafe branches.

name.description: Display name of the food item.

imageKey.description: Visual key for menu item card artwork.

imageUrl.description: Optional custom photo download URL from Firebase Storage or external HTTPS image URL.

badgeText.description: Optional badge label such as BESTSELLER or SPICY.

Promotion.title: Promotion
Promotion.description: Promo code supporting percentage or flat PKR discount.

minOrderPkr.description: Minimum subtotal in PKR required to apply.

branchId.description: Optional branch ID restricting this promo exclusively to customers of that branch (empty string for global promos).

branchName.description: Optional branch display name for branch-scoped promos.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp for temporary discount codes.

BranchBanner.title: BranchBanner
BranchBanner.description: Seasonal promotional banner image created by a Branch Admin that only appears for customers who selected that specific branch.

branchId.description: Branch ID that owns this seasonal banner.

title.description: Headline displayed on the seasonal banner.

promoCode.description: Optional linked branch promo code for one-tap apply.

badgeText.description: Short pill label such as SEASONAL OFFER or LIMITED TIME.

imageUrl.description: Firebase Storage download URL or HTTPS URL for the seasonal banner artwork.

targetCategory.description: Menu category to filter when a customer taps the banner.

active.description: Whether the seasonal banner is currently active.

expiresAt.description: Optional expiration timestamp after which the banner automatically hides.

UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated customer or staff profile with favorites and RBAC role.

assignedBranchId.description: Dynamic branch ID if BranchAdmin, or empty string.

favoriteItemIds.description: List of favorited menu item IDs.

SavedAddress.title: SavedAddress
SavedAddress.description: Customer delivery address mapped automatically to a dynamic branchId.

label.description: Short label like Home or Office.

streetAddress.description: Complete delivery address (House No, Street, Area, City).

landmark.description: Optional nearby landmark to help the rider.

BranchAdminEntry.title: BranchAdminEntry
BranchAdminEntry.description: Authorized Branch Manager assignment managed by SuperAdmin, keyed by normalized email for instant permission revocation.

email.description: Lowercase Google email of branch manager.

role.description: Assigned RBAC role for branch staff access.

CafeOrder.title: CafeOrder
CafeOrder.description: Customer or guest order routed to a dynamic branch with live status tracking and strict per-branch manager isolation.

guestSessionId.description: Temporary guest identifier if checked out as guest.

guestCheckout.description: True when placed via Guest Checkout flow.

deliveryAddress.description: Delivery address or Pickup counter note.

deliveryLatitude.description: Optional customer live GPS latitude attached at delivery checkout.

deliveryLongitude.description: Optional customer live GPS longitude attached at delivery checkout.

branchAdminEmails.description: Optional denormalized manager emails for reference/alerts.

OrderReview.title: OrderReview
OrderReview.description: Post-delivery customer rating and short comment for a delivered order.

FcmTokenRecord.title: FcmTokenRecord
FcmTokenRecord.description: Device Firebase Cloud Messaging token registered to receive real-time order status push notifications.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of device owner.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of last token refresh.

CafeFeedback.title: CafeFeedback
CafeFeedback.description: General customer feedback from account settings rating food quality and service.

foodRating.description: Food quality star rating from 1 to 5.

AdminDeliveryNotification.title: AdminDeliveryNotification
AdminDeliveryNotification.description: Persistent real-time admin notification created immediately when an order status changes to Delivered.

orderId.description: Firestore ID of the delivered order.

branchId.description: Branch ID that fulfilled the order.

totalPkr.description: Final order total in PKR (with FREE delivery Rs. 0).

read.description: Whether the admin has opened/read this notification.

deliveredAt.description: Server timestamp when order was marked Delivered.

/menu_items/{itemId}.description: Global Lahori Food Cafe menu catalog.

/promotions/{promoId}.description: Global and branch-exclusive temporary promo codes for percentage or flat PKR discounts.

/branch_banners/{bannerId}.description: Branch-exclusive seasonal banner images shown only to customers who selected that specific branch.

/users/{userId}.description: User profiles, favorites, and RBAC metadata.

/users/{userId}/addresses/{addressId}.description: Customer saved delivery addresses with optional landmark and auto-routed branchId.

/users/{userId}/fcm_tokens/{tokenId}.description: Registered Android FCM device tokens for real-time order push notifications.

/branch_admins/{adminId}.description: SuperAdmin-managed branch manager assignments locked by email and branchId.

/orders/{orderId}.description: Customer and guest orders routed to dynamic branches with permanent Rs. 0 FREE delivery.

/reviews/{reviewId}.description: Customer ratings and comments submitted after orders are delivered.

/feedback/{feedbackId}.description: General customer food and service ratings submitted from Account Settings.

/admin_notifications/{notificationId}.description: Persistent real-time admin order-delivered notifications scoped by branchId.
